snippet.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie -  A detective mystery full of clues, puzzles, and secrets!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://branegames.itch.io/let-sleeping-dogs-lie?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A message on your PDA. A missing journalist.

These simple events will pull you into an intricate web of lies. Who are the people behind the kidnapping? What is really going on?

A detective deduction game where you bring the interrogation forward!

Study the crime scene, connect clues, hack into systems, search databases, uncover the truth! Your trusty PDA opens up countless gameplay possibilities. You have everything you need to solve the case in your hands -- and brain!
